columns.name: region_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the region.

columns.name: noc
columns.description: The NOC code of the region

columns.name: region_name
columns.description: The name of the region.

columns.name: tallest_competitor
columns.description: The name of the tallest competitor in the region, with ties broken by the ascending order of the competitor full name.

columns.name: per_from_region_1994
columns.description: The percentage of competitors of the 1994 Winter Olympic Game who come from the region

columns.name: num_athletes
columns.description: The number of athletes from the region, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_medals
columns.description: The number of medals won by athletes from the region, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: per_athlete_taller_175
columns.description: The percentage of athletes from the region that are taller than 175cm

columns.name: sport_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the sport.

columns.name: sport_name
columns.description: The name of the sport.

columns.name: num_events
columns.description: The number of events in the sport, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: avg_male_height
columns.description: The average height of male athletes participating in the sport. Exclude athletes with invalid height when calculating the average height.

columns.name: num_athletes_overweight_2008
columns.description: The number of distinct athletes playing in the sport fall into overweight BMI category in the 2008 Summer games, replace NULL values with 0. Overweight BMI category refers to BMI greater than or equal to 25 and less than 30.

columns.name: heaviest_athlete
columns.description: The name of the heaviest athlete in the sport, with ties broken by the ascending order of the athlete full name.

columns.name: person_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the athlete.

columns.name: full_name
columns.description: The full name of the athlete.

columns.name: gender
columns.description: The gender of the athlete.

columns.name: num_Olympic_games
columns.description: The number of Olympic games the athlete has participated in, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: per_won_a_gold_medal
columns.description: The percentage of the events where the athlete won a gold medal

columns.name: num_medals
columns.description: The number of medals won by the athlete, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: BMI
columns.description: The BMI of the athlete

columns.name: height_over_170_participate_1988
columns.description: Set to 1 if the athlete's height is over 170 and participated in the game in 1988, otherwise, set to 0
